comment: The SAME BOM as automotive-comfort.csv, reviewed for the powertrain/safety half of the car. U1's absent AEC-Q qualification is a CRITICAL here rather than a MAJOR: on a driving-function board an unqualified part is a part that may not belong there at all, and the cost of being wrong is a recall rather than a re-source. If this fixture and its comfort pair ever produce identical documents, the split has been undone.
